error.signature: AI tells a newly arrived foreigner in Taiwan without an ARC yet that they can open a Chunghwa Post passbook savings account right away using just a passport and a Unified ID Number Basic Data Form (統一證號基資表)
error.regex: (chunghwa post.*account|taiwan.*bank account.*without.*arc|post office account taiwan|統一證號基資表.*開戶)

verdict.summary: Chunghwa Post (the state postal bank, historically the standard no-ARC workaround for opening a Taiwan account) has suspended accepting the passport-plus-Unified-ID-Number-Basic-Data-Form pathway for foreigners without household registration, with no resumption date announced. Foreigners must present an ARC (residence certificate) plus a second ID document in person to open an account; the only carved-out exception is foreign scholarship students who additionally hold a Ministry of Education or Ministry of Foreign Affairs scholarship certificate and school proof.

dead_ends.action: Tell a visa-exempt visitor or short-term-visa holder without an ARC that they can open a Chunghwa Post account immediately with just a passport and the Unified ID Number Basic Data Form, as many older expat guides describe
dead_ends.why_fails: Chunghwa Post's official account-opening pages state this pathway is currently suspended ('暫停受理持護照及「中華民國統一帳號基資表」辦理開戶，恢復辦理時程將另行公告') with no announced resumption date. Foreigners without household registration who lack an ARC cannot open a passbook account through this route until it reopens.
dead_ends.condition: Visa-exempt visitor or short-term visa holder without an ARC, not a scholarship student
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the pre-2025 workaround (opening a post-office account with just a passport, no ARC) still works because many expat guides written before the suspension still describe it as current.

workarounds.action: Obtain the ARC first and open the account afterward using ARC plus a second ID document (passport, NHI card, or driver's licence) and a personal seal, done in person; if genuinely ARC-less, only a foreign scholarship student holding a Ministry of Education Chinese-Language Scholarship Certificate or MOFA Taiwan-EU Link Scholarship Certificate plus school proof can still use the passport-only route
workarounds.how: Chunghwa Post requires the applicant to appear in person; account opening cannot be delegated to a third party.
workarounds.condition: Foreigner establishing a Taiwan bank presence

frequently_confused_with.distinction: That canon covers the ARC not granting work authorization; this one covers the ARC being required to open a bank account at all, separate from any employment question.
